fallback_semantics.required: Exact.stringify(actual) == expected_json literally, including empty/missing/malformed/changed private receipt and subclass cases.

Normal configure never earns such a receipt, but private-field/control fallback must preserve the old expression rather than silently changing acceptance.
fallback_semantics.shape: The compiled configuration root is always a Dictionary (including a legitimately empty Dictionary). Missing bits or wrong root type should take the original fallback; do not use bits.is_empty as an authenticity test. Arbitrary same-shaped reflection corruption of private bits is outside the existing private-wire trust model.
fallback_semantics.no_new_authentication_claim: Private data is never exposed or returned. This does not authenticate arbitrary private .set/reflection mutation, and no generic foreign-input validator or caller-approved flag is introduced.
